oracle: Gold sets are computed by a DETERMINISTIC LEXICAL RULE over the raw documents (a doc is gold iff it contains every keyword in `keywords`, case-insensitive) and/or by the document type declared in documents/index.json. The retriever never sees the keywords - it only embeds the natural-language question - so lexical gold + semantic retrieval keeps the oracle independent of the system under test. Questions whose sponsor hint names only a document TYPE are scored on type accuracy alone. `style` marks whether the question repeats the keywords (entity) or avoids them entirely (paraphrase); paraphrase items are the ones that actually test semantic retrieval.
